description: This header defines template classes for plugin monitoring and interface management within the Thunder framework, including plugin activation/deactivation handling, and RPC interface access for plugins and controllers.

classes.name: PluginMonitorType
classes.description: Template class for monitoring plugin activation and deactivation, managing interface pointers, and notifying handlers.

classes.name: SmartInterfaceType
classes.description: Template class for managing RPC interfaces exposed by plugins, handling activation/deactivation, and connection management.

classes.name: PluginSmartInterfaceType
classes.description: Template class for plugin-side RPC interface management, handling plugin activation/deactivation, and interface access.

classes.name: SmartControllerInterfaceType
classes.description: Template class for managing controller RPC interfaces, connection lifecycle, and interface querying.

methods.name: IsOperational
methods.description: Checks if the plugin or interface is operational.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a plugin or interface with the system.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a plugin or interface from the system.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a plugin or controller.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the connection to a plugin or controller.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires a specific interface version from the plugin or system.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Callback for subclasses to handle operational state changes.
